verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Workable serves an llms.txt documentation index at workable.readme.io/llms.txt. Its reference pages are also served as markdown (.md) and point agents to that index, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (download disabled, paths return 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs.
